items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Rex Stewart was promoting some of my jazz things out in Long Island somewhere... I was invited to go out there and Rex came by and I sang a few things.

ctx.x: I was just digging through my notes here.
These were some concerts that Rex Stewart was promoting. He lived out there at the time. He lived out in Babylon.
